title: Jazzy Shredded Middle Eastern Chicken Stock Knafeh
description: A tangy and energizing Middle Eastern dessert featuring shredded chicken stock and crispy double-rise-bread, all wrapped up in an earthenware bowl.
instructions: To begin, preheat the oven to 180°C.
Cut the double-rise-bread into small cubes and toast in the oven for 10 minutes.
In a large bowl, mix together the shredded chicken stock, ghee, rose water, pistachios, syrup, cinnamon, and cardamom.
Layer the toasted bread and chicken stock mixture into an earthenware bowl.
Repeat the layering process until all ingredients are used up, finishing with a layer of bread on top.
Bake in the oven for an additional 20 minutes, or until the bread is crispy and golden.
Serve warm, garnished with additional pistachios and rose water if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
